# algeria-melbet.com

This site contains public landing pages about live football, casino games, offers, and partnership information for Algeria. The visible interface supports English, French, and Arabic.

## Public pages
- https://algeria-melbet.com/ : Homepage with landing content for live football, casino games, and offers.
- https://algeria-melbet.com/partnership/ : Partnership page covering benefits, onboarding, partnership models, and reporting.
